methodology.heading: How this list is built
paragraphs: The tracker lists bills and joint resolutions in the {congress} Congress whose title names artificial intelligence, machine learning, deepfakes, digital replicas, generative or algorithmic systems, chatbots or related technology, plus the bills our articles cover. A bill whose Congressional Research Service summary mentions these terms, but whose title doesn’t, goes to a review queue; we add it only after reading it. Simple and concurrent resolutions are left out because they can’t become law.

Status follows each bill through five steps: introduced, reported by committee, passed one chamber, passed both chambers, and became law. It describes that bill only. When a bill’s text is enacted inside another bill, often the annual defense authorization, the original bill stays at its own step.
Titles, actions, sponsors, cosponsors, committees and summaries come from the Congress.gov API, run by the Library of Congress. This list reflects Congress.gov as of {date}; we refresh it by hand.
